fields.title: 7. Corrections and Resolutions from the Previous Round
fields.md:
- **No corrections** — the figures and verdicts of Round 10 (11/4) stand as they are. The source-side after-the-fact revision of the 11/3 trading volume (Section 3) is a record, not a correction (Source: `reports/2026-11-04-event.md`).
- **Resolved**: 'EchoStar 3Q26 10-Q (wireless subscribers, SpaceX reimbursement amount, licenses held for sale pending approval)' (T9 open item) → **partially resolved** — wireless revenue, OIBDA and the SpaceX license book value of $8,667M confirmed; for subscribers only the reported figure (7.193M); **the 3Q value of the 'SpaceX reimbursement amount (first half $413.7M)' is not in the XBRL and remains unresolved** (outside the 86K-character range of the 10-Q body) (Source: Section 2).
- **New open items**: ① Bloomberg 11/4 original (403) — primary confirmation of $8.3 billion, $7 billion, $47.3 billion and PIMCO ② Payer and timing of the $7 billion prepayment (if SpaceX cash, the 4Q26 10-K cash flow statement) ③ Qualcomm press release body (only the title rendered) ④ Terrestrial network CAPEX, site count, tower partners — SpaceX disclosures (10-K purchase commitments, CAPEX guidance) ⑤ Boost subscribers and SpaceX reimbursement amount (3Q) in the EchoStar 10-Q body ⑥ Measurement-layer share — the linking rule by which the monitor attached the 'financing' event to T1 · DA 26-1078 deposit (FCC ICFS not wired) (Source: Sections 1–2, 5).
